ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Adani Green Energy Limited - Provisional Operational Update H1 FY27**  Adani Green Energy Limited reported a robust H1 FY27, marked by a 24% year-over-year increase in operational capacity to 20,763 MW and a 32% rise in energy sales to 25,747 million units. This significant growth is underpinned by efficient operations, including high plant availability, substantial expansion of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) capacity, and consistently exceeding Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) generation commitments by 110-114%. The document primarily highlights positive operational performance and progress towards long-term targets, presenting no immediate red flags within this operational update.
